sources.title: Heilmittelwerbegesetz (HWG) — Law on Advertising in the Health Care System
FSA Code of Conduct (Freiwillige Selbstkontrolle für die Arzneimittelindustrie)

medical.title: Advertising consistent with Fachinformation
medical.check_prompt: Flag claims inconsistent with the supplied German Fachinformation / SmPC. Missing FI → [GAP].

medical.title: Prohibited advertising statements (HWG themes)
medical.check_prompt: Flag absolute success guarantees, fear appeals, or before/after style claims typical of HWG restrictions when unsupported. Do not cite section numbers unless supplied.

legal.title: Public vs professional advertising boundary
legal.check_prompt: Flag Rx advertising that would be directed to the general public. HCP-only materials must not read as consumer ads.

legal.title: Benefits / samples / hospitality
legal.check_prompt: Flag offers of benefits inconsistent with FSA-style industry rules. Escalate; do not clear.

regulatory.title: Mandatory particulars for specialist advertising
regulatory.check_prompt: For Fachkreise advertising, check for required particulars (e.g. name, composition themes, contraindications as applicable to format). Incomplete → finding or [GAP].

regulatory.title: EU pack is not a substitute
regulatory.check_prompt: If only the EU-central pack was applied for German materials, flag that DE rules must also be applied.
